learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn to use position words like 'in', 'on', and 'under' to describe where a person, animal, or thing is.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Where is your favorite toy right now? 🧸 Is it ON the bed, IN the box, or UNDER the table? Today, we will learn the magic words that tell us WHERE things are hidden!

lesson_modules.module_title: 📍 What are Position Words? (जगह बताने वाले शब्द)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: Position words tell us where a naming word (Noun) is. In grammar, they are called Prepositions (सम्बन्धसूचक अव्यय). They act like a map!
We use the word 'In' when something is inside another thing.
examples_or_templates: The pencils are IN the box. ✏️📦
The fish is IN the water. 🐟💧

lesson_modules.teaching_content: We use the word 'On' when something is resting on top of another thing.
examples_or_templates: The book is ON the table. 📚🪑
The cat is sitting ON the mat. 🐈🟩

lesson_modules.teaching_content: We use the word 'Under' when something is right below another thing.
examples_or_templates: The dog is sleeping UNDER the table. 🐕🪑
The ball rolled UNDER the bed. ⚽🛏️

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Where do you keep your books when you go to school?
❓ The fan is up, but the carpet is ___ the table.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank: The bird is sitting ____ the tree branch.
subjective_practice.hint: Is the bird inside the branch or resting on top of it? (in / on)

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Look at your shoes. Are your feet ____ your shoes?
subjective_practice.hint: Your feet go completely inside! (in / under)

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank: We sit ____ a chair.
subjective_practice.hint: Do you sit inside a chair or on it? (in / on)

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Where do you hide from the rain using an umbrella? ____ the umbrella.

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎨 Teddy Bear Hide and Seek
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Take a small teddy bear. First, put it IN a cup. Then, put it ON a plate. Finally, hide it UNDER a pillow! Say the position words out loud as you play.

chapter_summary: ⭐ Position words tell us where a person, place, animal, or thing is.
⭐ 'On' means resting on top of something.
